_doc: Host profile for B5 — MacBook Pro, Apple M5 Max, 128 GB unified memory. Selected by hostname 'B5' or HOST_ID=b5. Nothing here is exposed off-box: there is no tunnel, so publicUrl equals localUrl throughout.
name: B5

memory._doc: ONE pool shared by CPU and GPU. There is no VRAM/RAM distinction to budget across: a model's weights are simply resident memory. The console shows a single Memory bar here and hides the separate System RAM section, and the fit check treats a model's full footprint as one number.

services.name: Service Manager
services.note: Same supervisor as on BeTenshi (scripts/manager.cjs), started by hand or by launchd; not a scheduled task.

services.name: Ollama
services.note: Every text and vision model on this box is served here, on Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1 surface. `llm.model` is the default the LLM tab talks to; the other pulled checkpoints (gemma4:31b-mlx, qwen3-vl:32b-instruct) are one `model` field away. Usually owned by Ollama.app (menu bar), in which case the manager adopts the process rather than spawning its own. Cloud is disabled in ~/.ollama/server.json and it listens on loopback only.

services.name: Local AI Toolkit
services.note: Loopback adapter over the verified /Users/alibadereddin/LocalAI toolkit. Draw Things supplies FLUX.2 image generation/editing and Wan video; MLX-Audio supplies Qwen3 ASR and preset-voice TTS. The adapter serializes heavy work and never downloads models or exposes a public listener. The historical service id `qwen` is retained because Image Studio routes that id through its established generation, gallery, queue, and edit paths.

workstreams._doc: One service, so one workstream. Ollama also serves vision (qwen3-vl, gemma4) but the console has no vision surface pointed at it yet, so offering an Image or Vision card here would advertise work this host cannot actually do.
